Full Stack Engineer — Praverse Tech (Fresher)
We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer & Technical Lead who can independently manage frontend and backend development across our web and mobile application projects.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain frontend and backend applications.
- Work on responsive web applications and support mobile application development.
- Build and integrate APIs, databases, authentication systems, dashboards, admin panels, and third-party services.
- Review existing code, identify issues, improve performance, and resolve bugs.
- Support deployment, production fixes, version releases, and environment management.
- Perform functional testing, regression testing, API testing, and end-to-end software testing.
- Take ownership of assigned software projects from development through testing and deployment.
- Guide and supervise junior developers, review their work, assign technical tasks, and ensure timely completion.
- Support AI integrations, APIs, automation workflows, and other emerging technology integrations where required.
- Maintain clean, scalable, secure, and well-documented code.
Required Skills
- Strong knowledge of modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
- Strong backend development knowledge using technologies such as Node.js, Python, or equivalent frameworks.
- Experience working with REST APIs, databases, authentication, and cloud/backend platforms.
- Understanding of PostgreSQL, SQL, Supabase, Firebase, or similar platforms.
- Experience with Git/GitHub and collaborative development workflows.
- Good understanding of mobile application architecture and API integration.
- Ability to test applications systematically and troubleshoot both frontend and backend issues.
- Experience with deployment and cloud environments is preferred.
- Familiarity with AI/LLM API integrations will be an advantage.
We value ownership, problem-solving ability, speed of execution, attention to detail, and accountability more than simply the number of technologies listed on a résumé.
Experience: Preferred 2–4 years of relevant full-stack software development experience. Candidates with slightly lower experience but strong technical ownership and practical project experience may also be considered.
